method: Read all 391 source/target pairs in six sequential batches: 747–809, 810–899, 900–979, 980–1059, 1060–1134, 1135–1169. The file omits previously completed pilot strings; exact reviewed IDs are listed. Reviewed semantics, qualifiers, numbers and limits, prompt/source distinctions, original language and labels, Korean phrasing, and MDX links. Programmatic link comparison was supplementary to reading.
